answer: You can still sell us the car, but you pay the difference between your payoff and our offer at the appointment, by cashier's check or debit card; we don't accept personal checks or credit cards. Bring a payoff letter from your lender, which we compare with the offer and which speeds things up. You don't need the title, since your lender holds it while the loan is open, and we pay the lender off directly from your offer. The help center refers to an appointment checklist but doesn't list what's on it, so please contact a store for the full list.
